body:
## Verified conditional result

The increase over the latest comparable [external #8057](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086) at **0.00389821** is **1361743/100000000000000** or **(1361743/3898210000)%**. The new rate also clears #8073's exact stopped ceiling. The external comparison uses #8057's exact checked scientific head. Its later head adds optional measurement.

The physical same-stage volume bound funds the smaller tariff 2401/1024 at both ordinary moments. It raises the geometric sum from 376 to 2401. Charge five more entry clock bits and three per terminal stage before comparing the whole invoice. The exact envelope funds ordinary debit 11178/8192. The smaller grid point 11177/8192 and the preceding tariff at the new price fail directed controls. The coarse-volume control at tariff 75/32 gives unit contraction. With the same signed native words and Gaussian debit, the capped crossing installs ordinary heights (8192,111681,524288) and Gaussian height 509812. Both neighboring Gaussian slices miss the target on their binding inequality. The argument closes this three-stage family under the specified prices and ceiling.

The complete recurring clock decreases by 11 log units relative to #8073. Its first terminal activation moves later by 2494 exponent units. #8057 retains the lower recurring price by 32469 and a portable bound for its own measured setup scope.

The current overlap review covered Clear1nsight’s fixed-value Gaussian reroute exclusions in [#8074](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8074) and Gaussian frame-price exclusions at trial κ 0.0039 in [#8075](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8075). Those finite exclusions leave the ordinary child tariff and the complete comparable κ benchmark open.
